title: Reclaim 0.1.1-1570
body:
<!-- synopkgland:release:synopackageland%2FSynoReclaim:0.1.1-1570 -->

Reclaim **0.1.1-1570**

### en

0.1.1-1570
- Full-volume ext4 scans show progress during aggregation.
- Page headers keep titles and actions readable in narrow windows.
- One click opens page notes from the info button.
- Removing the entry from its portal page asks for confirmation and explains how to enable it again from the DSM desktop.

### zh-TW

0.1.1-1570
- ext4 整卷掃描在彙整階段顯示進度。
- 標題列在窄視窗不再擠壓。
- 頁面附註的 ⓘ 一點就開。
- 在入口頁移除入口前先確認，並說明如何從 DSM 桌面重新啟用。

Package: `synopackageland/SynoReclaim`

[Browse packages / 瀏覽套件](https://synopkgland.com/apps/)
